sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2008 Porsche Cayman, finished in black with a black interior. This Cayman features the desirable 5-speed manual transmission. According to the build sheet provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes Sound Package Plus, 17-inch wheels, Porsche Stability Management, an adjustable rear spoiler, leather upholstery, power-adjustable and heated seats, and cruise control. Notable modifications reported by the seller include an aftermarket cat-back exhaust, a carbon-fiber rear ducktail spoiler, a PCCM Plus-style aftermarket head unit, LED interior lighting, and clear side-marking lights. Porsche introduced the original Cayman as the Boxster's long-awaited coupe counterpart for the 2006 model year. Called 987 internally, it was more than merely a Boxster with a fixed top and a hatch, and about 20 percent of the parts used to build it were new. Some enthusiasts placed the Cayman's chassis above the 911 in the Porsche pecking order because it was nimble, quick, and extremely well-balanced. Power comes from a 2.7-liter flat-6, rated at 245 horsepower and 201 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 5-speed manual transmission.

sections.Seller Notes: The tires on this Cayman carry 2021 and 2022 date codes. The seller reports that some corrosion found on the driver-side A-pillar was repaired by a local body shop, and the windshield was replaced, with no additional corrosion found during inspection.
